howToFill: Paste each team's Showdown export into teams[].showdown, give it a title and a one-line note, then run: node tools/build-campaign.mjs giuseppe . championsbattledata.com/giuseppe redirects straight into the Team Builder (_redirects) and builder/campaign-teams.js reads this file there. The tool fills in generatedAt and each team's members from data/builder/app-data.json: that list is the proof every paste resolves, and tests/run-campaign.mjs fails if a paste is here without it, which is what stops a mistyped name silently dropping a Pokemon out of a team. Leave a team's showdown empty and it is simply skipped.
